Q1: PASS. The recovered delta is chosen before native handle Tick and used by the native renderer. Raw wall time remains separate. Cancellation/readiness happen first; newly queued casts are accepted after advancement. Direct native Update semantics remain unchanged.
Q2: PASS. Ordinary wall steps, fallback sprite/ASCII clocks, caster helper lifetime, conditions, copied geometry, materials and game outcomes retain their contracts. Contact eligibility uses the same floor/next interpolation and physical visibility predicate as drawing. Diagnostic fields explicitly identify raw and applied units.
Q3: PASS_WITH_STATED_LIMITS.27 cases cover real Jet/Rime Full/Reduced successes and counter-invariants, fractional sampling, threshold, queue, simultaneous handles, fallback, hidden/empty content, timeout and repeats. Existing outcome/33-readability-adversarial tests remain passing. No proof of arbitrary-framerate minimum pixel duration is claimed.
Q4: SOURCE_AND_FOLLOWUP_DOC_AGREE. Main follow-up explicitly records scope change, raw watchdog, preserved failed runs and limits. Earlier plan/preflight timing language needs an explicit cross-reference to this later correction; final native/media/full status remains pending.

hypotheses.finding: One pre-existing native presentation policy defect can erase a whole unseen contact interval after a long wall frame. Four actual imported command cases and two native-clock integration cases pin six reproduced paths, not six independent gameplay bugs.
Scenario double advancement is not the cause: mutually exclusive ZoneRenderer paths call coordinator once; zero-delta draw accepts new work without aging it.

R21 fallback fixture inherited an affected cell four cells away, extending actual sprite duration to .74s. Corrected only this new fixture; R21c then passes strict fallback/legacy completion and reaches genuine native recovery RED.
R22 CS0266 came from float StudyContactFrame assigned to int. Actual Ember contact29.5 makes rounding insufficient; floor/next interpolation now matches drawing and R22b passes.

Caster helper same-acceptance-frame delta charging is source-supported but not established as the cause of R19/R20. Existing independent gesture lifetime/controller restoration is unchanged; actual native gesture evidence remains required.
Eight additional adversarial cases were added after implementation review and pass; they are prevention-focused contracts, not eight bug fixes.
